title: Unblock CI package typecheck (add @types/node to shared packages)
origin: tech-debt.md line 35 (High, verified 2026-07-01): every ci.yml run since the 2026-04-18 monorepo move fails in Phase 1 'Validate Packages' -> 'Run package typecheck' (tsc --noEmit) for practice-core, core-convex, core-auth, ai-tutoring. Test/source files use node globals (node:fs/path/url/os, process, Buffer) but the package tsconfig lacks @types/node in its `types` field (TS2591), which also cascades implicit-any (TS7006). Because deploy needs:[im3,bm2] needs:[packages,boundary-check], a package typecheck red stops CI long before the Phase 6 Cloudflare deploy job runs, so IM3's CI deploy has never landed.
